exposure: Poor ovarian response to gonadotropin stimulation for IVF
poor ovarian response to gonadotropin stimulation for in vitro fertilization (IVF)
daily follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) ≥ 150 IU yielding ≤ 3 retrieved oocytes
cohort: 507 women aged 17-39 who underwent fresh embryo transfer and delivered a singleton neonate at a single center (excluding pre-implantation genetic testing) between 2007-2022.
finding: Poor ovarian response to IVF stimulation was not associated with increased adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes in young patients.
mod_finding: Poor ovarian response was not associated with cesarean delivery rate.
